notes.title: Indefinite Server Outage
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I come with some unfortunate and somewhat embarrassing news.
Some time in the last week, my SQL Database server (which [i]Run, Doodleguy![/i]'s network content is hosted on) was hacked into and fully wiped. The data is being held ransom for $42k, which in my opinion is not worth it (not to mention the insane debt I'd go into if I did pay it).

All Drawings, Collections, and User Info have all been wiped, and the game now freezes whenever you try to open the Network Menu.

Worst of all, this is happening in the midst of an extremely busy period in the development of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2701030/MINDWAVE/]MINDWAVE[/url], a game I am a project manager and programmer on. I do want to bring Doodleguy back online, but I'm not sure when I'll have the free time to make it happen.

As an apology for 75% of the game's content being made inaccessible, I'll shortly be dropping [i]Run, Doodleguy![/i]'s price to $2.99 USD (and let's be honest, the game should've been at this price from the start :P). If you're in a territory outside the USA and you believe Steam's auto-generated regional pricing is unfair, please let me know on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/MookalH]@MookalH[/url]) so we can discuss a better price for your region.

As my first ever commercial game release, this game still holds a very special place in my heart, and seeing this happen has put me in a really bad mood to say the least. There is a silver lining though.
Most of the people who have played this game are friends or otherwise acquaintances of mine. If their created drawings are still stored on their devices offline, I can let them know to reupload everything whenever I get the servers working again (i.e. whenever I am less busy).
I have no idea when this will be though, so please don't hold your breath.

Thank you for reading, and I apologize for the inconvenience. I'll see you again when the update drops! ... ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch
notes.notes: - Fixed a crash that can happen upon starting the game.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch, and Happy Launch!
notes.notes:
Thanks to all players for the support on day one so far, it really means the world to me :)
Launch was rocky (had to delay the release by almost 3 days!), but it's turned out in the end, and I've learned a lot from the past few days.
I've got a lot more plans for games in store, and I'm infinitely grateful for everyone who's chosen to follow me on my journey. It's gonna be a great one!

Also, I've fixed a pesky bug one of the playtesters has found.
- Fixed a bug that let players pause the game to cheat death.

Happy drawing!
